datasets.name: Landslide remote sensing image dataset (Sichuan and surrounding areas)
datasets.verbatim: Based on the high-precision remote sensing images and interpretation datasets developed based on the landslide disasters that occurred in Sichuan and its surrounding areas published by Zeng et al. [20], we identified several areas where landslides frequently occur, and 1215 remote sensing images of landslides were collected to construct the dataset.

methods.name: Reg-SA–UNet++ (RS–UNet)
methods.summary: A lightweight semantic segmentation network based on UNet++ that uses RegNet as the encoder, incorporates Shuffle Attention modules at each layer's connection, and removes deep supervision-pruning. It is designed for landslide detection using single-temporal post-landslide optical images.
methods.source: Chaoyang Niu, Ouyang Gao, Wanjie Lu, Wei Liu, and Tao Lai

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced to Zeng et al. [20] but lacks a direct link, and the custom code for the Reg-SA–UNet++ method is not provided or linked.
